design.name: 犀渠
design.brief: 犀渠 from the Shan Hai Jing (a man-eating ox-like beast, blue-black, crying like a baby), reborn as a desert tank: a massive low rhino-ox with a huge head and a broad sandstone brow plate like a battering ram, one thick nose horn, small angry glowing eyes, hide of big cracked ochre sandstone plates carved with faded Dunhuang cloud patterns, dark blue-black skin showing in the gaps. Stocky pillar legs with two-toed hooves, short tufted tail. A torn Dunhuang saddle blanket with bronze bells hangs over its back; between the shoulder plates a glowing white-gold sun-fire scar (weak spot). Tank: lowers the brow plate to guard and charges.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions like the jerboa soldier and fire rat of this roster: chunky simplified masses, oversized head and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Its defence is part of its own body: it holds NO shield and NO weapon.
